title: Approval
description: A record that a human authorised something specific. The agent records it; the agent cannot be it.

gate.description: Which gate this authorises. An approval for one gate never satisfies another.

kind.description: How the authorisation reached the record. There is no 'agent' value on purpose. founder_policy is a scope approval the Founder gave in advance, by marking a roadmap item; it names him and cites that item.

channel.description: Where it was given — a session, a PR review, a protected-branch rule. Free text, because it is a pointer for a human, not a proof.

scope_digest.description: Digest of the artifact the human approved. It binds the approval to content; it does not prove authorship or consent.

expires_with_revision.description: True means: a new revision of the approved artifact invalidates this approval.

preparation.description: The preparation snapshot this approval was granted over. Content and contract are not enough: the artifact record is in neither, so an approval that named only those kept matching across a reopening that replaced exactly that record.

integration_target.description: The integration this approval authorises. A merge is confirmed against the PR that was approved, never against any PR whose merged tree happens to match.
